definitions.name: U1D.SUM
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> its sum (0 for an empty Vector)

definitions.name: U1D.MAXV
definitions.body: 'U1D.MV' BIND U1D.MV U1D.MV 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> its largest element (works for negatives, seeded with the first element)

definitions.name: U1D.ARGMAX
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> index of its first largest element (ties go to the earliest)

definitions.name: U1D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'U1D.TR' BIND U1D.TR KEYS U1D.TR VALUES U1D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> the first key holding the largest value

definitions.name: U1D.PRESENT
definitions.note: Vector -> its non-NIL elements, in order

definitions.name: U1D.NILMASK
definitions.note: Vector -> same-length numeric Vector, 1 where the element is NIL and 0 elsewhere

definitions.name: U1D.MEAN
definitions.body: 'U1D.MM' BIND U1D.MM U1D.SUM U1D.MM LENGTH DIV

definitions.name: U1D.MOD
definitions.body: 'U1D.MB' BIND 'U1D.MA' BIND U1D.MA U1D.MA U1D.MB DIV FLOOR U1D.MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a mod b (floor remainder); lifts over Vectors

definitions.name: U1D.RLE
definitions.body: G0D.RUNS [ 'U1D.RR' BIND U1D.RR 0 GET U1D.RR LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> run-length encoding, a Vector of [ value count ] pairs in order

definitions.name: U1D.FFILL
definitions.body: 'U1D.FV' BIND U1D.FV U1D.FV U1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'U1D.FE' BIND 'U1D.FA' BIND U1D.FA U1D.FE U1D.FE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector with NILs (at least one present) -> forward-filled Vector; leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: U1D.GAPS
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector of its runs of consecutive NILs, each run a Vector of 1s (LENGTH gives the gap length)

definitions.name: U1D.BSTATES
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of G0A.BSTEP stack Strings after each character ('#' means the prefix so far is balanced)

definitions.name: U1D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER 'U1D.CW' BIND U1D.CW CHARS 0 GET UPPER U1D.CW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case

definitions.name: U1D.QTYS
definitions.body: 'U1D.QO' BIND U1D.QO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP U1D.QO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'U1D.QG' BIND U1D.QG KEYS U1D.QG VALUES [ U1D.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record from sku to its summed qty, skus in order of first appearance

definitions.name: U1D.REVENUE
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'U1D.RO' BIND U1D.RO 'qty' GET U1D.RO 'price' GET MUL ] MAP U1D.SUM
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total of qty times price over the orders that have a price
